description: This list highlights some of the best colour printers available in India under Rs. 20,000, suitable for homes, students, and small offices. Models such as the HP Smart Tank 675, HP Smart Tank 580, Canon PIXMA MegaTank G4780, Brother DCP-T535DW, and Epson EcoTank L3250 offer print, scan, and copy functions along with wireless connectivity. These printers feature refillable ink systems for lower running costs, decent print speeds, and high-resolution output. Most models support mobile printing and are designed to handle moderate monthly workloads efficiently.
title: Best Colour Printers Under Rs 20,000 in India From Brands Like HP, Canon and More

description: The Expedition 74 crew aboard the International Space Station is preparing to release Japan’s HTV-X1 cargo spacecraft after four months docked. Using Canadarm2, the vehicle will detach, conduct additional experiments in orbit, and later deorbit, while astronauts continue biology and AI research onboard.
title: ISS Crew Prepares to Send Japan’s HTV-X1 Cargo Spacecraft Back to Earth After Four Months

description: Nothing Phone 4a and Motorola Edge 70 compete in the midrange segment with AMOLED displays, triple rear cameras, and Android 16-based software. The Nothing Phone 4a features a Glyph Bar interface, Snapdragon 7s Gen 4 chipset, periscope camera with up to 70x zoom, and a 5,400mAh battery. The Motorola Edge 70 offers a slimmer build, a Snapdragon 7 Gen 4 SoC, stronger durability ratings, and faster 68W charging with wireless support. In India, the phones are priced starting at Rs. 31,999 and Rs. 29,999, respectively.
title: Nothing Phone 4a vs Motorola Edge 70: Price in India, Features and Specifications Compared

description: Here's a quick comparison of the Nothing Phone 4a and Phone 3a based on their price in India, features and specifications. Both phones offer Nothing's signature Glyph interface and feature triple rear camera units. They have AMOLED displays with 120Hz refresh rates and similar dust and water resistance ratings. The new phone runs on the Snapdragon 7s Gen 4 chipset, while last year's model runs on the Snapdragon 7s Gen 3 SoC.
title: Nothing Phone 4a vs Phone 3a: Price in India, Specifications Compared

description: A month after launching a dedicated Codex app for macOS, OpenAI has now launched the app to Windows devices as well. On Wednesday, the San Francisco-based artificial intelligence (AI) giant announced that the app is now available in the Microsoft Store, and developers using the Windows operating system can now use the app for agentic coding as well.
title: OpenAI’s Codex App Is Now Available on Windows, Can Be Downloaded via Microsoft Store

description: Andhaka is a Telugu drama-thriller that explores friendship, betrayal, and emotional truth through the life of a visually impaired man.
title: Andhaka OTT Release: Where to Watch the Telugu Drama-Thriller Online?

description: Google introduced the Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite artificial intelligence (AI) model on Thursday. Calling it the fastest and the most cost-efficient AI model in the Gemini 3 series, the Mountain View-based tech giant said it is designed for high-volume developer workloads. The model is currently not available to end users and has been reserved for developers and enterprises via specific channels.
title: Google Introduces Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite as Its Fastest and Most Cost-Efficient AI Model

description: Granny is a suspense thriller about a couple who uncover dark secrets surrounding a mysterious old woman in their ancestral village.
title: Granny OTT Release Date: When and Where to Watch the Village Mystery Thriller Online?

description: Over the past few days, the Cupertino-based company has refreshed its iPhone, iPad, MacBook Air, MacBook Pro, and display product categories. Apple kicked off the week by unveiling the iPhone 17e, positioned as a more affordable addition to the iPhone 17 lineup. The phone is powered by Apple’s A19 chip. The company also launched a new iPad Air with the M4 chip. The company refreshed the MacBook Air with the M5 chip and updated the MacBook Pro with Apple’s new M5 Pro and M5 Max chips. Apple also unveiled its MacBook Neo, an affordable laptop with an A18 Pro chip.
title: iPhone 17e to MacBook Neo: Here's Everything Apple Launched This Week

description: Nothing Headphone (a) was launched in the global markets on Thursday, as the latest addition to its over-ear audio lineup. The new headphones have been introduced alongside the Nothing Phone 4a series as the second over-ear offering from the UK-based brand. The headphones are positioned as a more expressive and affordable alternative to the flagship Nothing Headphone 1, featuring a lightweight design, adaptive noise cancellation, and customisable controls with the brand’s signature industrial aesthetic.
title: Nothing Headphone (a) Launched With Adaptive ANC, Customisable Controls: Price, Specifications

description: Nothing Phone 4a has been launched in India and other global markets, along with the Nothing Phone 4a Pro. The new smartphones are scheduled to go on sale in India via Flipkart. The latest Phone 4a will be available for purchase in Black, Blue, Pink, and White colour options. The handset is powered by Qualcomm’s octa core Snapdragon 7s Gen 4 chipset, which is built on a 4nm Gen 2 TSMC process. It is backed by a 5,400mAh battery, with support for 50W wired fast charging. It is equipped with the new Glyph Bar interface, which comprises 63 mini-LEDs and six individually addressable zones.
title: Nothing Phone 4a Launched in India With Glyph Bar Interface Alongside Nothing Phone 4a Pro: Price, Specs

description: OpenAI teased the release of the GPT-5.4 artificial intelligence (AI) model on Wednesday. The San Francisco-based AI giant said that the major update to the existing model could arrive soon, making it the fastest launch teaser after the launch of a major model. Interestingly, on Tuesday, the company released the GPT-5.3 Instant to all ChatGPT users.
title: OpenAI Teases GPT-5.4 AI Model Launch Just a Day After Releasing GPT-5.3 Instant

description: Oppo’s upcoming Find N6 foldable is expected to launch in China in March, although the company has not revealed the exact date yet. Recent leaks suggest the phone may feature a 6.62-inch outer display and an 8.12-inch inner LTPO screen with adaptive refresh rates. It is tipped to run on the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset and include a Hasselblad-backed triple camera system with a 200-megapixel primary sensor. The handset could also pack a 6,000mAh battery with 80W wired and 50W wireless charging.
title: Oppo Find N6 Key Features, Colour Options Leaked Ahead of Imminent China Launch

description: Pookie, featuring Vijay Antony and newcomer Ajay Dhishan, is a Gen Z relationship drama exploring love, confusion, and breakups, streaming on ZEE5 from March 13, 2026.
title: Pookie OTT Release: When and Where to Watch Vijay Antony’s Romantic Drama Online?

description: Samsung has filed a design patent with the World Intellectual Property Organization (WIPO) in the US, which received registration approval earlier this month, on March 3. The patent document reveals the design of the purported clamshell-style foldable smartphone. The handset will reportedly feature two cover displays, along with a dual rear camera unit and an LED flash. If the phone goes into production, it would mark a shift from the company's current design. For context, the Samsung Galaxy Z Flip 7 sports a single 4.1-inch AMOLED display on the outside.
title: Samsung Patent Hints at Potential Clamshell-Style Foldable With Two Cover Displays

description: WhatsApp is said to be developing an optional premium tier called WhatsApp Plus for Android and iOS. According to WABetaInfo, the subscription could introduce new customisation tools, including themes, accent colours, and about 14 alternative app icons. Subscribers may also be able to pin up to 20 chats instead of the current limit of three and use exclusive ringtones. The plan could later add subscriber-only stickers and more interactive reactions. WhatsApp’s core messaging features will remain free, and pricing or launch details have not been announced.
title: WhatsApp Plus Paid Subscription Reportedly in Development With Additional Customisation Options, Up to 20 Pinned Chats

description: Honor 600 Lite has been launched with a 6.6-inch AMOLED display and a 6,520mAh battery with 45W charging support. It has a dual rear camera unit headlined by a 108-megapixel primary sensor and runs on a MediaTek Dimensity 7100 Elite chipset paired with 12GB RAM and 256GB storage. The Honor 600 Lite is currently available in Malaysia in two colour options.
title: Honor 600 Lite Launched With MediaTek Dimensity 7100 Elite, 6,520mAh Battery: Price, Specifications

description: Google on Wednesday announced a series of changes to the Android ecosystem aimed at giving developers greater flexibility in how they distribute apps and handle payments. As per the Mountain View-based tech giant, it introduces expanded billing choices on the Google Play Store, new programmes to support developers, and an initiative to make third-party app stores easier to install. The changes were announced as part of what Google described as “a new era for choice and openness” on Android.
title: Google Play Announces New Android Policies With Expanded Billing Options, Eases Access to Third-Party App Stores

description: Lava Bold 2 5G will be launched in India soon by the Noida-based smartphone maker as the successor to last year’s Lava Bold 5G. Additionally, a dedicated microsite for the upcoming smartphone is now live on Amazon, confirming that it will be sold in the country via the e-commerce platform. Moreover, the company has teased the design of the handset. The soon-to-be-launched Bold 2 5G will be equipped with a dual rear camera setup, housed inside a rectangular camera module. To recap, the Lava Bold 5G is powered by a MediaTek Dimensity 6300 chipset, paired with a 5,000mAh battery.
title: Lava Bold 2 5G India Launch Teased; Company Teases Design Ahead of Debut

description: Oppo and MediaTek jointly announced new on-device artificial intelligence (AI) capabilities for future smartphones at the Mobile World Congress (MWC) 2026. The two companies are collaborating to develop and deploy new AI features for Oppo phones that do not require cloud connectivity to function. The announcements were made at MediaTek’s AI for Life keynote on Wednesday.
title: MWC 2026: Oppo, MediaTek Join Hands to Showcase New On-Device AI Capabilities for Future Smartphones

description: Nubia Neo 5 GT has been unveiled at the MWC 2026. The new gaming-focused smartphone has a 6.8-inch AMOLED display with 1.5K resolution and 144Hz refresh rate. It runs on a MediaTek Dimensity 7400 SoC and has a 360-degree game antenna. It carries a 6,210mAh dual-cell battery with up to 80W wired charging support and bypass charging support.
title: Nubia Neo 5 GT With MediaTek Dimensity 7400 SoC Launched at MWC 2026: Price, Specifications

description: Upcoming flagship phones from OnePlus, iQOO, and Redmi may launch at higher prices, according to tipster Digital Chat Station. Models such as the OnePlus 16, iQOO 16, and Redmi K100 Pro Max could start at around CNY 5,000 (roughly Rs. 66,000) for the 12GB + 256GB variant. These devices are expected to use next-generation chips like the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 or MediaTek Dimensity 9600. Higher production costs, including expensive 2nm wafers from TSMC and rising memory prices, may drive the increase. Some brands may also reserve 2nm chips for premium models.
title: OnePlus 16, iQOO 16, Redmi K100 Pro Max Tipped to Launch at Higher Prices This Year

description: Vivo teased the launch of the Vivo T5x 5G in India on Thursday. It is expected to arrive as the successor to the T4x 5G, which was introduced in March 2025. Alongside its launch confirmation, the brand has highlighted its benchmark score, suggesting that it will focus on performance within the mid-range segment. While its specifications have yet to be announced, leaks suggested that the upcoming Vivo T5x 5G will be powered by the MediaTek Dimensity 7400 Turbo chipset.
title: Vivo T5x 5G Teased to Launch in India Soon; Company Says AnTuTu Score Exceeds 1 Million Points

description: NotebookLM is one of Google’s most frequently updated artificial intelligence (AI) products. In the last few months, the AI-powered learning platform has received a large number of new features across the website and mobile apps. But on Wednesday, the Mountain View-based tech giant released one of the biggest upgrades to NotebookLM with the Cinematic Video Overviews feature.
title: Google's NotebookLM Upgraded With Cinematic Video Overviews Feature

description: Infinix Note 60 Ultra has been launched globally by the Chinese smartphone maker as the flagship addition to the company’s Note lineup. The phone was unveiled on Thursday during the Mobile World Congress (MWC) 2026 in Barcelona, Spain. The new Infinix Note 60 Ultra is scheduled to go on sale in select global markets via the company’s online store. It will be offered in Amalfi Blue, Monza Red, Roma Silver, and Torino Black colourways. While the company has yet to reveal the pricing of the phone, it was reportedly spotted on the company’s website in Malaysia.
title: Infinix Note 60 Ultra Launched at MWC 2026 With Pininfarina Design, Satellite Calling: Price, Specifications

description: Realme Narzo Power 5G has been launched in India in two colour options. It has a MediaTek Dimensity 7400 Ultra 5G chipset under the hood. It has a 6.78-inch display and a 50-megapixel Sony IMX882 main rear camera.
title: Realme Narzo Power 5G With 10,001mAh Battery Launched in India: Price, Specifications

description: The Moto Watch offers a premium design language and a large 1.4-inch OLED display. The silicone straps that come with the smartwatch offer a comfortable fit. It also comes loaded with interesting features, including dual-frequency GPS, a speaker, an IP68 rating, workout tracking, Nightly ANS recharge habits, and more. Check out the review to know more about the latest Moto Watch.
title: Moto Watch Review: The Best Smartwatch Under Rs. 6,000 in 2026?

description: Nothing has teased the Nothing Phone 4a Pro ahead of its launch, revealing a silhouette with a Glyph Matrix display on the back. The feature, first seen on the Nothing Phone 3, uses micro-LEDs arranged in a pixel grid to show alerts, widgets, and custom notifications. The standard Phone 4a will use a simpler Glyph Bar design and launch in Black, Blue, Pink, and White. The Phone 4a may start at Rs. 31,999, while the Pro could begin around Rs. 40,000.
title: Nothing Phone 4a Pro Teaser Suggests Presence of Phone 3's Glyph Matrix Panel

description: In new Weibo posts, OnePlus China’s President, Li Jie Louis, has officially announced that the OnePlus 15T will come with IP66, IP68, IP69, and IP69K ratings for dust and water resistance. It will also come with a 7,500mAh battery with support for 100W wired fast charging and 50W wireless fast charging. The battery uses Glacier Battery technology. The launch date of the OnePlus 15T is currently under wraps, but it is likely to go official later this month.
title: OnePlus 15T Teasers Confirm Larger Battery, Faster Charging Speed and Higher IP Rating

description: Oppo smartphones will soon support file transfers with Apple devices through Android’s Quick Share, the company announced at the Mobile World Congress (MWC) 2026 in Barcelona on Wednesday. The move is expected to enable compatibility with AirDrop, allowing Oppo users to send and receive files directly with iPhones and other Apple devices, eliminating the dependency on third-party apps. The development is aimed at improving cross-platform interoperability between Android and Apple devices.
title: Oppo Find X9 Series to Support Cross-Platform File Sharing With AirDrop via Quick Share

description: Xiaomi 17T will be launched in India by the Chinese smartphone maker at the end of April or in May, according to a tipster. If this is true, the rumoured handset would be the third model in the upcoming lineup in the country. For reference, the Xiaomi 17 series, which will include the Xiaomi 17 Ultra and the standard Xiaomi 17, is scheduled to be unveiled in the country on March 11. The two phones were launched in select global markets on February 28 in Barcelona, Spain. The purported Xiaomi 17T is expected to succeed last year’s Xiaomi 15T.
title: Xiaomi 17T India Launch Timeline Leaked as Firm Gears Up for Xiaomi 17 Ultra's Debut in India

description: Xiaomi is said to be planning to upgrade its in-house chips for its smartphones on a yearly basis. Speaking to a publication on the sidelines of the Mobile World Congress (MWC) 2026 in Barcelona on Wednesday, officials reportedly said that the China-based company plans to deploy its proprietary mobile processors in Xiaomi devices sold globally, not just on its home turf. The company is also working on expanding its artificial intelligence (AI) assistant for overseas markets.
title: Xiaomi to Reportedly Refresh In-House Smartphone Chips Annually; Eyes Global Expansion of AI Assistant
